source.authors: Goutte S, Reyes-Velasco J, Boissinot S
source.title: A new species of puddle frog from an unexplored mountain in southwestern Ethiopia (Anura, Phrynobatrachidae, Phrynobatrachus)

measurement: tympanum visibility in the holotype description
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype: adult male SB440 (field number; Addis Ababa University herpetology collection), Bibita Mountain, southwestern Ethiopia, collected 17 June 2018; one individual. Preceding sentence of the Description describes the body, snout and canthus; following sentence is 'Pupil horizontal.' The paper calls the tympanum hidden and never absent: Abstract 'a completely hidden tympanum'; Comparisons use the same phrase; no Variation sentence on the tympanum (nine paratopotypes, eight females and one male, not described for it).
where: Systematic account > Phrynobatrachus bibita sp. n. > Description of the holotype (also in the Diagnosis)
note: Name: Amphibian Species of the World URL path amphibiansoftheworld.amnh.org/Amphibia/Anura/Phrynobatrachidae/Phrynobatrachus/Phrynobatrachus-bibita appeared in a WebSearch result (page itself not opened); AmphibiaWeb page returned only a robot-check page and was not used; GBIF/other not opened, so registry check is by search-result URL path only (unchecked beyond that). Holotype sex and 'Description of the holotype' heading as printed. Printed year: the XML citation line prints 2010 for Goutte et al. while the article's publication-date metadata and ZooKeys 824 are 2019; 2019 filed, the 2010 is a visible typo on the exact copy. The printed title names the family Phrynobatrachidae. Page-printed licence sentence on the exact copy (publisher JATS XML), read in pieces: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Not on main: grep of docs/ for bibita and zookeys.824.31570 finds nothing (zookeys.824.31635, a Collembola paper by desk-d293, is another paper). Diagnosis repeats 'Tympanum not visible.' and Table 1 gives ED 2.5 mm for SB440 (not filed). Anatomy only; hearing not tested. Registry (audit 468): Amphibian Species of the World page itself is robots_disallowed and was not opened; its species URL path Amphibia/Anura/Phrynobatrachidae/Phrynobatrachus/Phrynobatrachus-bibita appeared in two WebSearch results; AmphibiaWeb's search-result title prints 'Phrynobatrachus bibita Goutte, Reyes-Velasco & Boissinot, 2019' (page gave a robot check); the Wikispecies 2023-01 snapshot of Phrynobatrachus lists 'P. bibita' under 'Familia: Phrynobatrachidae'. No synonymy seen. Name accepted, Phrynobatrachidae as printed in the title. Year (audit 468): the publisher JATS front matter prints pub-date 2019 (electronic publication 12 February 2019) and 'ZooKeys 824: 53–70'; only the self-citation line prints '(2010)', a typo; 2019 is the printed year of the issue. Crossref not returned (client error); the licence rests on the publisher's own free full text, an accepted case. Holotype wording printed: heading 'Description of the holotype.', first sentence 'Adult male (Figure 2; Table 1), body slender, ...'; Material: 'A male (SB440; Figure 2), collected on 17 June 2018, at night, in Bibita Mountain, southwestern Ethiopia'; Methods: 'All specimens are deposited at the Herpetology Collection of the Addis Ababa University, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.' Not on main (audit 468 grep of docs/ for bibita, 824.31570, ashaninka, 645.11221): only the desk-d354 files. Value 'tympanum not visible' is the printed wording and claims no absence.

source.title: A new species of Pristimantis (Amphibia, Anura, Craugastoridae) from a montane forest of the Pui Pui Protected Forest in central Peru (Región Junín)

measurement: tympanic membrane and annulus in the holotype description
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype MUSM 36517 (field number IWU 361), adult female, collected 15 May 2014 at 1700 m, border of the Pui Pui Protected Forest, Distrito Pichanaqui, Chanchamayo, Junin, Peru; one individual (fourteen paratypes: four females, ten juveniles; none described for the tympanum). The sentence also records a short, broad supratympanic fold. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
where: Systematic account > Pristimantis ashaninka sp. n. > Description of holotype, first sentence (cut with a mark)
quote: Head slightly narrower than body … supratympanic fold short and broad, extending from posterior margin of upper eyelid slightly curved to insertion of arm; tympanic membrane and annulus absent; two conical postrictal tubercles present bilaterally.
note: Name: Pristimantis ashaninka Lehr & Moravec, 2017 (Wikipedia and AmphibiaWeb search listings); Amphibian Species of the World page not opened (not in search results); AmphibiaWeb page returned a robot check and was not used. Family (audit 468): the paper prints Craugastoridae in its title; Strabomantidae filed. Amphibian Species of the World species page is robots_disallowed and was not opened, but its current URL path in a WebSearch result is Amphibia/Anura/Brachycephaloidea/Strabomantidae/Pristimantinae/Pristimantis/Pristimantis-ashaninka (an older path under Craugastoridae/Ceuthomantinae also appears); the Wikipedia Pristimantinae article (2026-03 snapshot) lists Pristimantinae among 'the subfamilies and genera ... in the family Strabomantidae', citing ASW and Ortega et al. 2025; the Wikipedia P. ashaninka taxobox says Strabomantidae. Strabomantidae taken as registry-correct. Main is mixed: Craugastoridae for P. achupalla (desk-d344), P. pluvialis and P. pulchridormientes (desk-d343) and oa-2 rows; Strabomantidae only for P. euphronides (oa-5). Sentence read in nine consecutive WebFetch pieces from the publisher JATS XML directly after the heading 'Description of holotype.' (no earlier text in that paragraph); quote is the sentence start (pieces 1) plus pieces 7 to 9 with one marked cut (…) of pieces 2 to 6 (snout, eye-nostril distance 77% of eye diameter, canthus, loreal region, upper eyelid tubercles and width); the cut drops no qualifier of the tympanum clause. Diagnosis item (2) prints 'tympanic membrane and tympanic annulus absent;'. Page-printed licence sentence on the exact copy (publisher JATS XML), read in pieces: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Printed ZooKeys 645, 2017, pages 85-102. Not on main: grep of docs/ for ashaninka and zookeys.645.11221 finds nothing. Anatomy only; hearing not tested. Audit 468 re-read the XML: title, authors Edgar Lehr, Jiří Moravec, 'ZooKeys 645: 85–102', citation line '(2017)', copyright holders without year, the CC BY 4.0 sentence, and the whole holotype sentence in nine pieces; heading 'Description of holotype.'; Holotype 'MUSM 36517 (IWU 361), an adult female'; Paratypes 'Fourteen' (four females, ten juveniles); no Variation sentence on the tympanum; Comparisons say P. wiensi 'has a tympanum (absent)'. Crossref not returned (rate limit, then client error on the other DOI); the licence rests on the publisher's own free full text. Not on main (audit 468 grep of docs/ for ashaninka and 645.11221): only the desk-d354 files.
